profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: Everything here is embedded into your agents' brand context on the next run.
profile.name: Business name
profile.websiteHint: Used by the website analyzer and competitive research.
profile.languageHint: Language the agents write in by default.
profile.currencyHint: Used for budgets and performance figures.
profile.monthlyBudgetHint: Your planning figure. Leave empty for none.
profile.dailyTokenBudgetHint: Overrides the platform default. The Usage screen reads the same value.
profile.brandVoiceHint: How the brand speaks. The most-used field after the offers.
profile.targetAudienceHint: Who this is for, in your own words.
profile.goalsHint: What success looks like this quarter.
profile.keyOffersHint: Products, pricing and promises worth repeating.
profile.listClearHint: Removing every row and saving clears the whole list.
profile.semanticsOmit: A field you never touch is not sent, so the stored value stays exactly as it is.
profile.semanticsClear: “Clear” erases a value: short fields (industry, website, currency, budgets) are stored empty, and long text (brand voice, visual style, audience) is stored as an empty string.
profile.semanticsList: Removing every row of a list clears it.
profile.readOnlyRole: Your role on this workspace is Viewer, so the profile is read-only. Ask an owner or member to change it.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Provider credentials for this workspace. Resolution order is workspace → environment → default.
connectors.summary: Environment: {environment} · {count} connector(s) overridden for this workspace.
connectors.resetHint: Drops this workspace's override and falls back to the process environment.
connectors.readOnlyRole: Connector settings are owner-only. You can see what is configured but not change it.
connectors.noEncryptionKey: No token encryption key is configured for this deployment. Secrets are stored using the development fallback — set TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY before going live.
connectors.emptyDescription: This deployment exposes no connector configuration.

usage.description: Token spend for this workspace, straight from the usage ledger.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every approval, execution and configuration change, with the user who made it.

audit.emptyDescription: Nothing has happened in this workspace that changed state yet.
audit.ownerOnlyDescription: An audit log answers "what did a human change, and whose account did it" — the actor ids identify people. Ask a workspace owner if you need it.
